ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Discussion sessions will be conducted online using the Elluminate Live web conferencing software at a time arranged by the instructor. A microphone is recommended for this course. This section has one or more proctored exams which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers, and testing facilities located at the Online & Continuing Education offices on the Urbana-Champaign campus, which carry no fees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
